verdict.rationale: FreshBooks documents a broad REST API (invoices, expenses, payments, journal entries, reports, clients, taxes, bills-beta) with OAuth, webhooks, and an official SDK, covering most core accounting workflows an AI agent could drive. However, several UI-surfaced features (Bill Pay automation, Payroll, Team member management, human Bookkeeping service tier) are only described as product/marketing features with no corresponding API endpoints in the evidence, and there's no independent confirmation of full UI-API parity. Missing for 10: API coverage confirmation for Bill Pay, Payroll, Team Members, and Bookkeeping service; independent/hands-on verification of parity claims.
